about.title: ❓ Help & About
about.body:
I'm a bilingual AI assistant on Telegram.

• 💬 Chat freely with memory and context
• 🎭 Tune personality, tone and creativity
• ✨ Use text tools (summarize, translate, write, explain)
• 📚 Keep multiple independent conversations

Commands: /start /menu /new /lang /help /cancel
about.credits:
Credits & acknowledgements
Built with aiogram, SQLAlchemy and an OpenAI-compatible API.
